title: Immortal time bias in survival reanalysis of MSK-CHORD: reproducibility code
description: Code to reproduce every number, table and figure of the manuscript "Reanchoring overall survival at diagnosis without accounting for delayed entry overstates survival in clinical genomic cohorts: immortal time bias in MSK-CHORD". The code downloads the public MSK-CHORD files from cBioPortal, builds the analytic dataset and runs all analyses. No patient-level data are redistributed.
